query: What measurable QA acceptance criteria should we set for site data (e.g., energy balance discrepancy, attribution error, per-unit CI widths)?

response.query: What measurable QA acceptance criteria should we set for site data (e.g., energy balance discrepancy, attribution error, per-unit CI widths)?
response.answer: For site data, set QA acceptance criteria for energy balance discrepancy below 5%, attribution error below 2%, and per-unit CI widths below 10%.

results.title: Evaluating Data Quality: Comparative Insights on Standards ... - MDPI
results.content: *   [Regulatory Frameworks for Data Quality](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-9292/14/15/3038#sec3-electronics-14-03038). *   [Data Quality Assessment Methods](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-9292/14/15/3038#sec4-electronics-14-03038). The analysis focuses on the following four core areas: (i) types of data and associated quality issues; (ii) quality dimensions and formal standards such as the Findability, Accessibility, Interoperability, and Reusability (FAIR) principles and International Organization for Standardization/International Electrotechnical Commission (ISO/IEC) 25000 [[16](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-9292/14/15/3038#B16-electronics-14-03038)]; (iii) research-based methods for data quality assessment; and (iv) contemporary software solutions supporting data quality management. Essentially, quality dimensions offer quantifiable characteristics for evaluating and controlling the quality of data and information [[23](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-9292/14/15/3038#B23-electronics-14-03038)]. A significant policy framework that establishes thorough standards for data quality management among member states is the European Guidelines 2021 [[35](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-9292/14/15/3038#B35-electronics-14-03038)]. Comprehensive data quality models are established by ISO 25000, process maturity benchmarks are provided by ISO 15504/CMMI frameworks [[49](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-9292/14/15/3038#B49-electronics-14-03038)], and software verification and validation are governed by ISO 12207/IEEE 1028 standards [[50](https://www.mdpi.com/2079-9292/14/15/3038#B50-electronics-14-03038)].
